Dave's Killer Bread® White Bread Done Right® is our take on sliced white bread, featuring killer taste, an artisan-style texture and no bleached flour. You can trust Dave's Killer Bread® to deliver killer taste, texture and always be Non-GMO Project Verified. White Bread Done Right® is just what you need for killer club sandwiches and fluffy PB&Js. For soft and smooth white bread, try Dave's Killer Bread® White Bread Done Right®.

The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

sections.bodyString:
Our pasture-raised soy-free hens are on a soy-free diet that makes their eggs not only ideal for those with soy allergies, but also for anyone who wants a very good-for-you egg — and cares about how hens are treated.

After all, everything a hen eats and how a hen is raised has a big impact on the quality of the eggs they lay.

Because our soy-free hens are pasture-raised and Certified Humane, they get plenty of sunlight, and this makes their eggs naturally higher in vitamin D — as does the absence of soy which tends to deplete vitamin D.

Additionally, these eggs are non-GMO thanks, in large part, to the fact that they are soy-free, since soy is often genetically modified. Plus, we choose feed that contains no other genetically modified grains or ingredients.

Our hens’ happy, pasture-raised lifestyle on family farms also reduces stress. So, when we say our soy-free hens are enjoying life, we mean it.

However you use it, I Can’t Believe It’s Not Butter!® Light proves that making a lighter choice can still deliver flavor and nutrients to every meal. "

Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops have the original, delicious chocolate-flavored taste you love, now with no added sugar and only 40 calories per pop! These frozen dairy dessert pops can be enjoyed anytime and anywhere. Take a fudge pop out of the freezer after dinner, or bring them in a cooler to the beach or park for a frozen treat the whole family can enjoy. Fudgsicle is part of the Popsicle family, which has been offering treasured American treats for over 115 years. In 1905, when he was 11 years old, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold, waking up the next morning to find that his drink had frozen like an icicle. This ice pop was a hit with his friends, and a classic was born. Be sure to try our other products in the Popsicle family and discover your new favorite frozen dessert. In 1916, two young Polish immigrants named Nathan and Ida Handwerker put down their $300 life savings to open a frankfurter and french fry stand on Conney Island, New York. They called it Nathan's Famous! In addition to selling the country's newest taste sensation, the hot dog, Nathan and Ida served golden, crinkle cut french fries. Nothing like ordinary fries, these were made from fresh-peeled potatoes, cut thick and hearty with a unique, crinkly shape, and cooked to a crispy golden brown perfection. Today, Nathan's Famous hot dogs and crinkle cut fries are served the world over with exactly the same integrity and care. And now, you can enjoy the great taste of Nathan's Famous hot dogs and French fries right in your home!

sections.bodyString:
Essentia Water is Supercharged Ionized Alkaline Water so you can do the things that matter most to you and stop for nothing. Essentia’s proprietary three-step ionization process produces Overachieving H2O that’s 99.9% pure with a pH of 9.5 or higher and a clean, smooth taste. Step 1: Unwanted particles are removed through microfiltration and reverse osmosis, making Essentia 99.9% pure. Step 2: The water is infused with trace amounts of electrolytes; not just for taste, but to better complement the body’s natural mix. Step 3: Bitter-tasting acidic ions are removed, creating a high alkaline water with pH levels of 9.5 or higher. Available in a variety of sizes, Essentia Water bottles are recyclable, BPA-free plastic bottles available in cases and multi-packs. The 1.5-liter bottle is designed to store easily in the home, office, or personal vehicle for anytime hydration moments.

ReaLemon and ReaLime are space-saving kitchen sidekicks, ideal for adding a delicious twist of lemon or lime to your favorite seafood and poultry recipes. Spinach.

Cook thoroughly. Microwave Instructions: 1. Empty frozen contents of bag into a 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Add 2 tbsp water. (1 tbsp water for half bag). 2. Cover and microwave on high for 7-1/2 minutes for full bag; stir halfway through cooking. (4 minutes for half bag.)* 3. Let stand for 1 minute after cooking**. 4. Drain and serve. * Per 1200 watt microwave. ** Stand times is important for food safety. Stovetop Instructions: 1. Empty frozen contents of bag into a 2-quart non-stick saucepan. Add 1/2 cup water. (For half bag, add 1/4 cup water). 2. Bring water to a full boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium-high. 3. Cover and cook for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. (For half bag, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes). 4. Drain and serve. Cook thoroughly to a temperature of 165 degrees F as measured by a food thermometer taken in several spots. Caution! sections.bodyString: 100% all natural. Nothing artificial. No added spices. Only 5 ingredients. JerseyItalianGravy.com. Follow Us On: Facebook. Twitter. My story. As a young boy growing up in northern New Jersey, I distinctly remember hanging out after school with my friends at our favorite local pizzeria. We would play video games and eat what we thought was the best pizza and pasta in the world. I loved it so much, I even took on a part-time job there and set out to learn everything I could about making great pizzas and Italian food. Unfortunately for me, there was one recipe the restaurant wouldn't share - the one for their famous Italian gravy - that rich, hauntingly delicious tomato gravy that made everything it touched special. I would never forget its taste, but it would be decades before I learned its secrets. After spending many years as an executive in the corporate world, I decided to swap my tie for an apron and purchased that same legendary pizzeria, gravy recipe and all! I then soon realized that I was on to the next best thing - Jersey Italian Gravy! That's when my wife chimed in and said, Why don't we jar and sell this stuff? Good idea, honey! Today, I am happy to share with you that same Italian gravy I fell in love with years ago. Open a jar and I'm sure you'll smell the freshness, taste the difference and create some legendary dishes of your own! - Carlos Vega. Founder/President. Jersey Italian Gravy, LLC. Made in the USA.

Dave's Killer Bread® Good Seed® Thin-Sliced is USDA organic bread loaded with seedy texture and sweet flavor. It has the bold, sweet flavor of regular Good Seed® bread loaf, but in thin-sliced form with 70 calories per slice. 3g fiber, 520mg ALA Omega-3 and 13g whole grains per slice. That's what we call big nutrition in a little slice! Plus, each Non-GMO Project Verified, USDA organic bread slice features a seed-coated crust providing the killer texture you know and love from Dave's. Dave's Killer Bread has no high-fructose corn syrup, no artificial preservatives and no artificial ingredients. You can trust Dave's Killer Bread to deliver killer taste, texture and whole grain nutrition. Good Seed® Thin-Sliced is the sliced bread you need for sandwiches, toast and snacks. With heavenly texture and saintly flavor, Good Seed® Thin-Sliced is the boldest and sweetest of our breads.

The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

sections.bodyString:
Our pasture-raised soy-free hens are on a soy-free diet that makes their eggs not only ideal for those with soy allergies, but also for anyone who wants a very good-for-you egg — and cares about how hens are treated.

After all, everything a hen eats and how a hen is raised has a big impact on the quality of the eggs they lay.

Because our soy-free hens are pasture-raised and Certified Humane, they get plenty of sunlight, and this makes their eggs naturally higher in vitamin D — as does the absence of soy which tends to deplete vitamin D.

Additionally, these eggs are non-GMO thanks, in large part, to the fact that they are soy-free, since soy is often genetically modified. Plus, we choose feed that contains no other genetically modified grains or ingredients.

Our hens’ happy, pasture-raised lifestyle on family farms also reduces stress. So, when we say our soy-free hens are enjoying life, we mean it.
Shell Eggs

sections.bodyString:
Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops have the original, delicious chocolate-flavored taste you love, now with no added sugar and only 40 calories per pop! These frozen dairy dessert pops can be enjoyed anytime and anywhere. Take a fudge pop out of the freezer after dinner, or bring them in a cooler to the beach or park for a frozen treat the whole family can enjoy. With 18 delicious pops per pack, there are plenty of frozen dairy dessert pops for everyone! Fudgsicle is part of the Popsicle family, which has been offering treasured American treats for over 115 years. In 1905, when he was 11 years old, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold, waking up the next morning to find that his drink had frozen like an icicle. This ice pop was a hit with his friends, and a classic was born. Be sure to try our other products in the Popsicle family and discover your new favorite frozen dessert. If you love the taste of our Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops, try our other varieties of the classic fudge pop. 
 
• Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops are just like the original chocolate flavor frozen dairy dessert pops you know and love, but with no added sugar
 
• A low sugar dessert packed with chocolatey goodness, each Fudgsicle ice pop is like having a fudge treat on a stick
 
• A responsible treat! These frozen dairy dessert pops only have 40 calories and no sugar added
 
• Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops are an easy dessert that can be enjoyed anytime and anywhere
 
• With 18 chocolatey fudge pops per pack, there are more than enough frozen dairy dessert pops for the whole family to enjoy
 
• Fudgsicle is created by Popsicle, a family favorite brand of frozen dairy dessert pops for over 115 years

Frozen Fudgsicle Hot Chocolate. What You'll Need: 1 Cup Unsweetened Almond Milk. 1 Sugar-free Hot Chocolate Packet. 1 No Sugar Added Fudgsicle Dairy Dessert Pop (From Fudgsicle No Sugar Added The Original Fudge Pops Box). Unsweetened Whipped Cream, Optional. Instructions: 1. In A Medium Saucepan Over Medium Heat, Add 1 Cup Almond Milk And Bring To A Light Boil. Add Hot Chocolate Packet And Stir Until Smooth. 2. Bring Heat To Medium-low And Add 1 Dairy Dessert Pop To The Saucepan. 3. When Dairy Dessert Pop Melts, Remove Wooden Stick (about 3 Minutes). Set Mixture Aside To Cool. 4. In A Blender, Add Hot Chocolate Mixture And About 2 Cups Of Ice. Blend Until Smooth. Pour Frozen Hot Chocolate Into Glass. If Desired. Top With Whipped Cream.

Popsicle Orange, Cherry, and Grape Ice Pops are a classic staple from summers past - and now you can get them with no sugar added! There’s a flavor for everyone in this box of delicious and refreshing fruit pops, with each ice pop containing only 15 calories, 0 g of saturated fat and 0 g of sugar. Even better, these classic frozen ice pops are now made with natural colors! Everyone has a favorite flavor. What’s yours? Is it cherry? Orange? Grape? Each ice pop flavor is equally delicious to us. This box of sugar free ice pops is perfect for any occasion; serve it at a party or just keep it in the freezer for an easy dessert. Popsicle Ice Pops have been a treasured American treat for over 115 years, and they remain a family favorite ice pop. In 1905, when he was 11 years old, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold, waking up the next morning to find that his drink had frozen like an icicle. This ice pop was a hit with his friends, and a classic was born. Be sure to try our other products in the Popsicle family and discover your next favorite frozen dessert. 
 
• Popsicle Sugar Free Ice Pops are an easy dessert for any occasion. Each variety box is packed with three classic flavors: orange, cherry, and grape

sections.bodyString:
Get ready to experience a cool new sensation this summer with the Popsicle Spiderman frozen confection pop! He’s returned, and he’s cooler than ever. This isn’t just a frozen treat; it’s a flavorful journey into a world of adventure that will have you swinging from web to web. The Popsicle Spiderman pop is the perfect trifecta of flavors to capture your taste buds in a delicious web of imagination and tastiness. With the tantalizing tastes of strawberry, blue raspberry, and lime, these frozen confection bars will transport you on an exciting journey of fun and adventure. Each pop is a responsible treat, containing only 6g of sugar and a mere 50 calories. This makes it a sensible choice for those hot summer days, allowing you to serve these yummy desserts to your little superheroes without reservations. As we remain committed to our promise of using colors from natural sources, each of these delightful desserts boasts bold, natural colors. Popsicle, the original ice pop brand, continues to inspire imagination and creativity with its fruity flavors. And with the Spiderman frozen confection pop, we’re taking it a swing further. We are talking about a superhero dessert that will win any battle against other ice cream bars or regular ice cream options! This delicious frozen treat is sure to get your spider-sense tingling, making it a preferred choice for any fan of the popular superhero over any regular peanut butter dessert or plain ice cream cone! Who would you like to share one of these Popsicle Spiderman pops with? 
 
• POPSICLE SPIDERMAN FACEPIECE: He's back, and cooler than ever! Savor the taste of summer as you swing into a world of flavor with the new Popsicle Spiderman frozen dessert pop!
 
• FLAVOR TRIFECTA: This frozen treat is a tasty web to catch your taste buds and transport you on a journey of fun and adventure with strawberry, blue raspberry, and lime flavors.
 
• ONLY 50 CALORIES: Each pop contains just 6g of sugar, making it a guilt-free frozen treat. So, you can feel good as a parent when serving this delightful frozen dessert to your little superheroes.
 
• NATURALLY SOURCED COLORS: Grab one of these yummy dessert bars and enjoy as we stay true to our commitment that each of our frozen treats have bold, naturally sourced colors.
 
• ONE CREATIVE SWING: The original ice pop brand continues to inspire you with fruity flavors. Popsicle & the Spiderman frozen confection bar will boost your imagination more than any ice cream!
 
• SUPERHERO APPROVED: Get your spidey senses tingling for this deliciously colorful Spiderman frozen confection bar that any fan of the popular superhero will pick over your everyday ice cream bars.

sections.bodyString:
Our pasture-raised soy-free hens are on a soy-free diet that makes their eggs not only ideal for those with soy allergies, but also for anyone who wants a very good-for-you egg — and cares about how hens are treated.

After all, everything a hen eats and how a hen is raised has a big impact on the quality of the eggs they lay.

Because our soy-free hens are pasture-raised and Certified Humane, they get plenty of sunlight, and this makes their eggs naturally higher in vitamin D — as does the absence of soy which tends to deplete vitamin D.

Additionally, these eggs are non-GMO thanks, in large part, to the fact that they are soy-free, since soy is often genetically modified. Plus, we choose feed that contains no other genetically modified grains or ingredients.

Our hens’ happy, pasture-raised lifestyle on family farms also reduces stress. So, when we say our soy-free hens are enjoying life, we mean it.
Shell Eggs

sections.bodyString:
Our pasture-raised soy-free hens are on a soy-free diet that makes their eggs not only ideal for those with soy allergies, but also for anyone who wants a very good-for-you egg — and cares about how hens are treated.

After all, everything a hen eats and how a hen is raised has a big impact on the quality of the eggs they lay.

Because our soy-free hens are pasture-raised and Certified Humane, they get plenty of sunlight, and this makes their eggs naturally higher in vitamin D — as does the absence of soy which tends to deplete vitamin D.

Additionally, these eggs are non-GMO thanks, in large part, to the fact that they are soy-free, since soy is often genetically modified. Plus, we choose feed that contains no other genetically modified grains or ingredients.

Our hens’ happy, pasture-raised lifestyle on family farms also reduces stress. So, when we say our soy-free hens are enjoying life, we mean it.
Shell Eggs
